'''Ordo Eris''' was an [[asteroid]] [[space station]] that served as the stronghold of the [[Haxion Brood]] criminal syndicate.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> Located on the edge of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] in the [[Chorlian sector]],<ref name="Appendix" /> Ordo Eris was constructed in an asteroid remnant of a [[planet]] which had once been destroyed by ancient [[superweapon]]s.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> [[Sylar Saris]] became known as "The Slayer of Ordo Eris" when he [[Death|killed]] a couple of top bosses of Haxion Brood and stole a cache of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="Bad Territory">{{TBB|Bad Territory}}</ref> [[Sorc Tormo]], [[crime lord]] of the Haxion Brood, often enjoyed watching combat in the [[Haxion Fight Pit]] arena located on Ordo Eris. In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' to [[14 BBY]].</ref> the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]] was captured by a [[bounty hunter]] of the Haxion Brood and Tormo had Kestis fight various [[Species|creatures]] in the arena before he was rescued by his friend [[Greez Dritus]] in the ''[[Stinger Mantis]]''.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ordo Eris first appeared in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'', developed by [[Respawn Entertainment]].<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> Concept art for Ordo Eris was done by artist [[Gabe Yeganyan]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>

''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' stated that Ordo Eris was built on a piece of [[Polis Massa]];<ref name="Star Wars Book">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> however, the [[2025]] "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]" appendix later overrode this and moved it to the [[Chorlian sector]] on the other side of [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Appendix" />
